x: With such talent as we have outlined above, plus the services of field events men such as Robertson, Waldron and Holder, and the continued influx of new devotees of field events, we should not find it difficult to hold the lead we have established in the Southern Amateur Athletic League (Division 1).

Derrick Burfitt retained his title but only after a hard fight with young Robertson of Reading, who made his effort too soon, although we must confess the finishing post was not clear owing to spectators encroaching on the course.

Hunter, Robertson, Bailey and Harry Turner are new members as Seniors and Jim Purdy and Pete Hunt two promising Juniors. We have of course lost some of our Juniors to the Services, but there are a number of new ones to take their places.
